data.one_liner: A generic InheritedWidget-based provider for BLoC state management in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides BLoC objects down the widget tree using InheritedWidget while helping to avoid boilerplate. It automatically manages the lifecycle of the BLoC by calling its dispose method when the provider is removed.
use_when: You are using a custom BLoC pattern requiring basic stream management and disposal
You want a lightweight provider mechanism without heavy third-party state libraries
avoid_when: You are using modern state management libraries like flutter_bloc or riverpod
You need complex dependency injection containers
strengths: Automatic lifecycle management with BLoC disposal
weaknesses: Relies on a custom abstract Bloc class rather than official state management packages
Very basic feature set compared to modern alternatives

alternatives.name: flutter_bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is the official, widely-adopted package for BLoC state management with extensive tooling and community support.

alternatives.name: provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is the standard general-purpose dependency injection and state propagation tool in Flutter.

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: It offers a robust, compile-safe, and modern provider system that completely replaces InheritedWidget patterns.
